key_insight: Rejecting suspect literature-mined values can protect AI materials discovery from false leads more effectively than retaining erroneous data.
engineering_relevance: Layered data validation helps materials-screening models prioritize credible candidates rather than extraction artifacts.
method: Check schema, provenance, and physical admissibility.
Combine cross-source statistical consensus with model auditing.
Rank suspicious records for targeted review.
evidence_signal: In a controlled benchmark, the combined framework detected 81% of errors at 85% precision and brought held-out model accuracy within 3% of a clean-data-trained model.
watch_item: Validation remains imperfect: 30 of 112 accepted values were defective in a curated-reference audit, and missing measurement conditions limit record interpretation.
paper_title: No Value Is Better Than a Wrong Value: Finding and Handling Erroneous Data in Literature-Mined Datasets for AI
